0.0: Lalala. Hey, there. I've been singing lullaby to this egg I'm taking care of. I feel that by doing so, this egg will safely go to sleep. #bChief Tatamo#k said it's good to sing songs to the egg. Apparently it's great for the baby inside the egg.
0.1: My plan is to not just sing to this egg, but also play some instruments for it. Unfortunately, I do not have any instrument to play with here. I heard that Hankie, who lives in the forest, carries around a small pan flute. Have you seen it? I think if I can get a number of those small pan flutes, and combine them into one big instrument, then I think I'll really be able to play it myself. Will you help me gather up small pan flutes?

yes.0: Hankie's Pan Flutes are apparently very small. I'm guessing, maybe #b50#k of those will allow me to make a playable pan flute. Don't you think so?

no.0: I truly believe that by playing beautiful, soothing music to this egg, it will gently fall asleep, and eventually, a healthy, kind baby dragon will emerge!

1.0: Thank you. That must be the pan flute that Hankie was carrying around with. I'm not the very best at this, but if fix it here and there, I may have myself a very useful pan flute. Thanks for your help.

yes.0: Once the flute is ready, I'll go up to the tallest tree in this town and play it for the eggs. Hopefully you'll be around to listen to me play.

item.0: I'll need #b50 #t4000231#s#k in order for me to make a playable Pan Flute.

QuestInfo.name: Pam's Request
QuestInfo.1: I ran into #p2081004#, who's responsible for singing for the egg at #m240000000#. #p2081004# liked to sing, but was also interested in playing instruments, and wanted to make a big flute. In order to do so, she asked that I gather up #b50 #t4000231#s
QuestInfo.2: I gave Pam 50 #t4000231#s. Pam seemed excited by the prospect of making a huge pan flute out of those small pan flutes and eventually play beautiful music for the eggs.
